; minimal-surface.fk — the four primitive families as one recipe-callable door each
; (m4a of hati-os.form; the families derived in minimal-kernel.form).
;
; A recipe written against these doors runs identically on every kernel that
; proves the band — the surface IS the portability contract the Hati-OS kernel
; will be authored over. The doors:
;
;   INTERN  — ms-cell / ms-intern: a leaf, and a two-child composition under
;             MS-PAIR; identity computed from content (axioms 2+3)
;   OBSERVE — ms-arity / ms-child / ms-value / ms-same: read a composition
;             back; observation through the door makes it real (axiom 4 inward)
;   OFFER   — ms-ack-terminal / ms-ack-node / ms-thread / ms-choice: the ack
;             vocabulary {nothing, 0, 1, node}; threading node counter-offers
;             to the terminal; choice pops on fail = ack-0 (axiom 5, carrying
;             axiom 1 as its vocabulary — the BMF lane needs no further door)
;   PORT    — ms-port-out / ms-port-in: the membrane's two directions over the
;             filesystem carrier — efferent text out, afferent text back
;             (axiom 4 outward; the carrier varies, the door is invariant)
;
; BMA save/restore has NO door on purpose: hold a composition and it persists
; untouched (axiom 3) — the band proves that as its own claim.

(defn ms-cell (n) (intern_trivial_int n))
(defn ms-intern (a b) (intern_node (bp "MS-PAIR") (list a b)))

(defn ms-same (a b) (if (node_eq a b) 1 0))
(defn ms-arity (c) (len (node_children c)))
(defn ms-child (c i) (nth (node_children c) i))
(defn ms-value (c) (node_value c))

(defn ms-ack-terminal (v) (list 0 v))
(defn ms-ack-node (inner) (list 1 inner))
(defn ms-thread (r) (if (eq (nth r 0) 1) (ms-thread (nth r 1)) (nth r 1)))
(defn ms-choice (a b) (if (eq a 0) b a))

(defn ms-port-out (path text) (host_file_write_text path text))
(defn ms-port-in (path) (host_file_read_text path))

andsrc (flt-band-pool modsrc bandsrc)))
(defn flt-band-fns2 (modsrc bandsrc pool)
    (flt-band2 (flt-top modsrc (list) (list) pool) bandsrc pool))
(defn flt-band2 (mr bandsrc pool)
    (flt-band3 bandsrc (flt-top-env-snap bandsrc (nth mr 0) (nth mr 1) pool (nth mr 4))))
(defn flt-band3 (bandsrc br)
    (cons (flt-reserve-wrap-k (flt-count-lets bandsrc 0 (str_len bandsrc)) (nth br 2))
          (flt-rev (nth br 1) (list))))
(defn flt-modsrcs-top (modsrcs fns rbodies pool)
    (flt-modsrcs-top-env modsrcs fns rbodies pool (list)))
(defn flt-modsrcs-top-env (modsrcs fns rbodies pool env)
    (if (eq (len modsrcs) 0) (list fns rbodies (fk-lit 0) 0 env)
        (flt-modsrcs-top2 (flt-top-env (head modsrcs) fns rbodies pool env) (tail modsrcs) pool)))
(defn flt-modsrcs-top2 (mr rest pool)
    (flt-modsrcs-top-env rest (nth mr 0) (nth mr 1) pool (nth mr 4)))
(defn flt-band-sources-fns (modsrcs bandsrc)
    (flt-band-sources-fns2 modsrcs bandsrc (flt-band-sources-pool modsrcs bandsrc)))
(defn flt-band-sources-fns2 (modsrcs bandsrc pool)
    (flt-band2 (flt-modsrcs-top modsrcs (list) (list) pool) bandsrc pool))

; Compatibility door: older bands pass one list whose last source is the
; band and whose earlier sources are modules. Keep it as a stable recipe
; while new callers use the explicit band-sources door.
(defn flt-srcs-mods (srcs acc)
    (if (eq (len srcs) 0) acc
        (if (eq (len (tail srcs)) 0) acc
            (flt-srcs-mods (tail srcs) (flt-append acc (head srcs))))))
(defn flt-srcs-last (srcs)
    (if (eq (len (tail srcs)) 0) (head srcs) (flt-srcs-last (tail srcs))))
(defn flt-srcs-fns (srcs)
    (if (eq (len srcs) 0) (list)
        (flt-band-sources-fns (flt-srcs-mods srcs (list)) (flt-srcs-last srcs))))

; single-source door (prelude-free bands, mini programs)
(defn flt-src-fns (src) (flt-band3 src (flt-top src (list) (list) (flt-src-pool src))))

(fks-table-file
  (flt-band-sources-fns (list "") "(nothing)")
  (flt-band-sources-pool (list "") "(nothing)"))
